notes: Audio8-TTS-Preview-0.6b (litert-community/Audio8-TTS-Preview-0.6b rev 880dfa08) codec decoder fp16, 128 frames, on the Galaxy S26 GPU through the zoo sample app audio8_tts (LiteRT 2.2.0 CompiledModel, Options(GPU, CPU), Kotlin). The graph is created and runs with no error or log line, and its output ignores its input: the app's load-time check decodes one fixed set of 128 frames of codes on the GPU graph and on the CPU int8 decoder and correlates the two wavs (0.0097), then decodes all-zero codes on the GPU graph and correlates with the first GPU wav (1.0). Same result in three runs of the lane's check on 2026-10-10 00:0x-00:4x and in the supervisor's rerun at 01:07 (0.010). The app falls back to codec_decoder_int8_T128 on the CPU (the pipeline row audio8-tts-preview-0.6b__slow_ar_int8) and remembers the failure per OS build, LiteRT version and file size. No per-call latency was timed for this leg (the check reports the correlation only); the raw wavs were not kept. Entered as a row on the owner's answer to DECISIONS #200 (a), 2026-10-10.
